# LeakSanitizer suppressions for the loft interpreter ASan leak gate (@PLN85).
# Syntax: `leak:<substr>` suppresses any leak whose stack contains a frame whose
# demangled name contains <substr>.
#
# ir_read: the interpreter interns IR node/schema/store names as `&'static str`
# via an intentional, bounded `Box::leak` (interner-style, not a growing leak) —
# ~16 ir_read/ir_schema/ir_store round-trip lib tests report it. Documented in
# miri.yml. This is the ONLY class suppressed; every real interpreter leak stays
# visible and is gated by the shrinking count baseline (scripts/asan_leak_ratchet.sh).
leak:ir_read

# macOS dyld thread-local storage term-func registration on a spawned thread
# (the test harness watchdog): `dyld::ThreadLocalVariables::addTermFunc`, reached
# via `thread_start`. A one-per-thread SYSTEM allocation, not a loft heap leak — and
# absent on the Linux CI leg (different TLS impl), so this line is a macOS-only no-op
# there. Specific to the dyld frame so it never masks a real loft leak.
leak:addTermFunc
